job.title: [Post] WE'RE HIRING | TECH LEAD – SALESFORCE COMMERCE CLOUD (SFCC) Location ... looking for an ex…

tailoring.headline: Tech Lead – SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) | Java, Spring & API Integration | 5+ Years E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices, and CI/CD pipelines. Proven record designing and integrating PIM/ERP/MDM data flows, leading API migrations, and translating business requirements into robust solutions. Strong techno-functional consulting, agile teamwork, and AI-assisted development. Holds SAP Commerce Cloud certifications and a valid German work permit.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Tech Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Sumanjeeth Kour’s vision to drive innovative commerce experiences on Salesforce Commerce Cloud. With over five years leading SAP Commerce Cloud implementations for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java-based e-commerce platforms, API design, and large-scale integrations that align perfectly with the technical leadership this role demands.

bullets.label: **Platform Architecture**
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud architectures, implementing Java/Spring services, OCC REST APIs and micro-services that support high-traffic B2B/B2C storefronts.

bullets.label: **API & Integration Strategy**
bullets.text: Built robust PIM/ERP/MDM data pipelines and migrated complex APIs, ensuring seamless integration across enterprise systems—experience directly transferable to SFCC integration projects.

bullets.label: **Agile Tech Leadership**
bullets.text: Led cross-functional, international teams in agile sprints, performed code reviews, and mentored junior developers while driving CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Docker.

bullets.label: **AI-Assisted Delivery**
bullets.text: Leveraged generative AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, code generation, testing and documentation, boosting delivery speed and quality.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: Your commitment to building cutting-edge digital commerce on Salesforce Commerce Cloud resonates with my passion for creating scalable, customer-centric platforms. I admire Sumanjeeth Kour’s focus on innovation, rapid delivery and international growth, and I am eager to apply my proven SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, API integration skills and techno-functional leadership to help accelerate your SFCC roadmap and exceed client expectations.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Sumanjeeth Kour to lead high-impact SFCC projects, leveraging my 5+ years of Java-centric e-commerce platform delivery and integration expertise to drive innovative, scalable solutions for your global clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior e-commerce developer with 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud. I’m excited about the Tech Lead – SFCC role at Sumanjeeth Kour and would love to discuss how my Java, API integration and leadership experience can add value to your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Tech Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Tech Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud position. With over five years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong Java, API integration and agile leadership experience. I hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for your team.
